sources.title: Sequence-assignment validation in cryo-EM models with checkMySequence
sources.journal: Acta Crystallographica Section D Structural Biology

verified_locations.location: §2, Fig. 1; Model validation with a systematic sequence assignment
verified_locations.what_verified: Inputs are the corresponding cryo-EM map, coordinate model, and each chain’s sequence; the method assigns overlapping fragments to a reference sequence using map-derived residue-type probabilities. The examples use maps, chain sequences, and models to check register; the conclusion says detectable length varies with resolution, usually needs to exceed about 10 amino acids, and short shifts offset by adjacent insertions/deletions may be missed.

limitations: p-value is an empirical statistic for discriminating fragment sequence assignment, not a “probability that the model is wrong”; low resolution, missing/incorrect input sequence, a register error in the reference PDB itself, or too-short shifts can affect results. sources.title: AlphaFold predictions are valuable hypotheses and accelerate but do not replace experimental structure determination

verified_locations.location: “Comparing AlphaFold predictions with density maps”; Fig. 1
verified_locations.what_verified: High-pLDDT predictions were compared with experimental crystallographic maps; the examples include good matches, cases that disagree with the map but match the deposited model, unclear maps, and domain/backbone deviations.

verified_locations.location: Fig. 4, Table 1; “Using confidence (pLDDT) to estimate errors in AlphaFold predictions”
verified_locations.what_verified: Among the selected 102 high-quality structures/maps, about 10% of Cα atoms with pLDDT>90 deviated by >2 Å from the reference structure; the paper also shows confidence correlations but does not equate high confidence with correctness.

verified_locations.location: Methods: experimental maps, analysis, “Control experiments and limitations”
verified_locations.what_verified: Methods state that the sample was selected from 215 structures, with the main analysis using 102 high-quality entries with free R≤0.30; local predictions did not use PDB templates. The authors report the sample proportions, templates, and conformational/structural limitations.

sources.scope: Terwilliger et al., Nature Methods 21 (2024), 110–116; checked direct map comparisons, confidence/error statistics, methods, controls, and limitations.
limitations: This is a selected crystallographic sample: the 102 structures in the main analysis came from a specific SAD redetermination set and most residues had high pLDDT; the study proportions cannot be extrapolated to all AF models. Experimental structures/density depend on specific crystal conditions, and unclear maps or alternate conformations mean a discrepancy does not necessarily indicate that the prediction is absolutely wrong.
